Fragments of adjacent stories are visible at the top; the left edge of the first column is slightly cropped.

description: Screenshot of a verified @realDonaldTrump tweet dated 2/20/19 claiming a border wall section in New Mexico was completed January 30, 2019, '47 days ahead of schedule', with the hashtag #FinishTheWall.
